test_title: PYST 25: SSC JE ME - Reassoning (Held on: 14 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements. 

**Statements:**

Some scribbles are drawings.

Some drawings are paintings.

**Conclusions:**

I. All drawings are scribbles.

II. Some scribbles are definitely not paintings.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
__**Statements:**__

Some scribbles are drawings.

Some drawings are paintings.

__**Venn diagram:**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fbd210f89cb3342d4769ff2ee5329d3a823de1fdb19fc2e4de17d88e9c4afc1d.png] 

__Conclusions:__

I. All drawings are scribbles→ **Does not follow** → We have 'Some scribbles are drawings' and 'Some drawings are paintings' so not all drawing can be scribbles because some drawing are paintings thus the conclusion does not follow. 

II. Some scribbles are definitely not paintings→ **Does not follow** → From the given information we have no data about the relation between scribbles and paintings so it will be incorrect to conclude anything here therefore the conclusion does not follow.

So **neither conclusion I nor II follows.**

Hence, the correct answer is** "option (3)".**
